vaultScouting.evaluation: Flowers is a 6-3 / 185 ATH. On the Bolles sophomore sit he plays quarterback — designed runs for scores, a 45-yard rollout strike, and a snappy release. Florida has also looked at him at safety; this reel is not DB tape.
vaultScouting.comparison: Flowers comps to Justin Fields — 6-3 / 227 dual-threat QB with a long stride, off-platform arm, and the same athletic tools that also play in the secondary.
vaultScouting.projection: Flowers projects as a Year 1 developmental dual-threat / ATH, then he competes for the job in Year 2, with Year 3 starter upside if the pocket base catches the arm.
strengths: Flowers takes the designed QB run, jump-cuts the linebacker, and outruns the secondary for the long score.
Flowers rolls right and drives the deep ball 45 yards in the air, hitting the receiver in stride.
Flowers pulls the read, bounces outside, and wins the edge with a long stride.
Flowers extends the play when the pocket breaks and still gets the ball out with a snappy release.
vaultScouting.schemeFit: Flowers fits a dual-threat QB who can also be an ATH chess piece — this sit is exclusively quarterback, even if the board also lists safety.
